notes.title: Halloween update
notes.content:
Hello!

We got a new release for you all! Check the changelog below.


 Added new Halloween theme, available only in October
 Added support for new Mac Silicon Processors

notes.title: Zen mode Update
notes.content:
Hello!

We got a new release for you all! Check the changelog below.


 Improved stability
 Added a new zen mode with random images from internet
 Started to implement the Steam Input API to support gamepads


We are working hard now to support Steam Deck and enable the multiplayer mode.

notes.title: Winter update
notes.content:
Hello!

We got a new release for you all! Check the changelog below.


 Added new Christmas theme, available only in December
 Added two new levels
 Optimized image loading, now it's faster
 Added new hardcore mode
 Changed Normal and NSFW mode to be more easier
 Added support for MacOS
 Fixed rare case where the last level doesn't load
 A lot of stability improvements
